readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 想法 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: 相 supplies the sound family above 心. The heart sinks deep in thought, then lifts with a 想法—an idea—tracing third-tone xiǎng.

phonetic_component.relationship: The repository character source classifies this component as sound-bearing; the anchor fixes the modern reading and tone.
